item.title: Using Mermaid Diagrams in Technical Documentation
item.description:
Diagrams are essential for explaining complex systems and processes in technical documentation. Mermaid makes it easy to create and maintain diagrams using a simple markdown-like syntax, directly in your content files.

In this post, I’ll show several examples of diagrams you can create using Mermaid.

Flowchart Example

Let’s start with a basic flowchart showing a deployment process:

flowchart TD A[Code Changes] --> B{Code Review} B -->|Approved| C[Build & Test] B -->|Rejected| A C --> D{Tests Pass?} D -->|Yes| E[Deploy to Staging] D -->|No| A E --> F{Staging Validation} F -->|Pass| G[Deploy to Production] F -->|Fail| A G --> H[Monitor]

item.title: Creating My Digital Scrapbook
item.description:
Today I added a proper Digital Scrapbook section to my website. This is a place where I can post shorter, more casual thoughts and updates compared to my regular blog posts.

The implementation included:

  1. Creating a dedicated layout template for the scrapbook page
  2. Styling it with CSS to match the rest of my site’s aesthetic
  3. Adding a simple search functionality
  4. Setting up the proper directory structure for daily entries

I’m planning to use this space to document quick learnings, interesting links I find, and progress on various projects. It feels good to have a low-pressure space to jot down thoughts without the formality of a full blog post.

item.title: Website Improvements - March 31, 2025
item.description:
Today’s Website Improvements

Made several significant improvements to the website today:

Archives Page

  • Added a “Dailies” section to the Archives page with a clean calendar icon
  • Styled the link to align perfectly with the page design
  • Removed “Daily Logs” from the main menu for cleaner navigation

Home Page Redesign

  • Completely revamped the home page layout
  • Added “Also seen on:” section with aligned social media icons
  • Improved spacing and typography across the page
  • Made the layout more consistent with proper line heights
  • Kept only important navigation links underlined for better visual hierarchy

Added “Now” Page

  • Created a new “Now” page to showcase current activities
  • Implemented auto-updating timestamp using Git information
  • Added professional focus, learning, reading, and projects sections
  • Created a custom shortcode for timestamp display

Overall, today’s changes focused on better organization, improved navigation, and a cleaner, more consistent design across the site.
